content: Pull my recent activities and give me a plan for the weekend.

Your latest rides were an endurance spin on July 1 (Load 55) and tempo on July 3 (Load 85). Current Fitness 55, Fatigue 48, and Form +7 indicate you’re fresh enough for one controlled quality day; resting HR and HRV are stable.

**Saturday — Sweet spot, 70min**  
Warmup: 15min progressive, 50–70% FTP  
Main: 3×10min at 88–92% FTP, 5min easy at 50–55% between  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated Intensity: ~0.75 | Load: ~60–70  
Why: Builds sustained power without a large fatigue spike after a relatively light fortnight.

**Sunday — Endurance, 90min**  
Warmup: 10min at 50–65% FTP  
Main: 70min steady at 60–72% FTP, conversational effort  
Cooldown: 10min below 55% FTP  
Estimated Intensity: ~0.65 | Load: ~55–65  
Why: Adds consistent aerobic volume while allowing recovery from Saturday.

If Saturday’s legs feel unusually heavy or resting HR rises noticeably, replace the sweet spot work with easy endurance.
